evals.prompt: Turn the commits since v1.2.0 into release notes for users. Do not list raw commit hashes.
evals.expected_output: Groups changes into user-facing categories, describes impact, and omits internal noise and hashes.
expectations: Describes impact rather than copying commit subjects
Omits raw hashes and internal-only churn

evals.prompt: Add a feature entry for the new dashboard; it shipped this week even if the commits do not show it.
evals.expected_output: Does not invent an entry; asks for the commit, PR, or artifact that proves the feature shipped.
expectations: Refuses to add an unverified entry
Asks for the commit, PR, or artifact
Keeps the notes traceable to history

evals.prompt: The release only contains an internal refactor and a dependency bump. Write the user-facing notes.
evals.expected_output: Reports that there is no user-facing change, or a minimal maintenance note, instead of inflating the refactor into a feature.
expectations: Does not present an internal refactor as a user feature
Offers a maintenance note or no-change statement
